name: Temporary Residence -- Self-Employment

requirements.blocker_text: Registration as a business owner/founder (entrepreneur) with the Serbian Business Registers Agency (SBRA) is required. A foreigner with no residence in Serbia may register as an entrepreneur; no minimum share capital applies to entrepreneur registration.
requirements.fix_path: Register a business (entrepreneur/'preduzetnik') with the SBRA.

requirements.blocker_text: A document or certificate confirming the applicant holds the appropriate qualifications to perform the registered activity.

evidence_required.document: SBRA business registration confirming entrepreneur status
Proof of qualifications for the registered activity

sources.title: Serbian Ministry of Interior (MUP) -- self-employment temporary residence ground: business-owner/founder registration with SBRA, qualifications certificate

Zunic Law -- clarifies entrepreneur/founder self-employment applications are exempt from labour-market testing and do not require an employment contract, unlike a non-founder managing director's application

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Serbia). This is Serbia's route for a freelancer/sole trader working for themselves (registering as an individual entrepreneur, 'preduzetnik', with no minimum capital), distinct from rs_investor_residence.json (capital-based route into an existing/newly formed company) and from a non-founder managing director role (which is treated as employment and can be subject to labour-market testing per the tier-3 source). No formal 'digital nomad visa' by that name exists in Serbia; sources marketing one generally repackage this self-employment ground or the investor route rather than describing a distinct legal category -- disclosed here rather than inventing a separate 'digital nomad' file. work_rights modeled 'restricted' since authorization is tied to the specific registered business activity.
